presentation.label: QUICK VELOCITY+AFTERTOUCH ASSIGN
presentation.summary: Link a parameter to velocity or aftertouch by holding FIX or SAMPLER and turning its knob.
presentation.overview: Hold FIX and turn any knob on a sound page: that parameter is linked to velocity, and the turn sets how much. Hold SAMPLER and turn to link it to aftertouch instead. While either key is held, every linked knob shows its amount the way stock shows a performance or scene lock. It fills stock's own four velocity and four aftertouch slots of the selected sound, so the links save with the kit, show in SOUND SETTINGS as usual and keep playing on a unit without the mod.
highlights: Velocity or aftertouch to any parameter in one gesture
Stays on the page you are playing
Uses stock's slots, saved with the kit
usage: Select a sound track and press FLTR. Hold FIX: FRQ and RES show 0 boxes, the new kit's velocity links.
Keep FIX held and turn FRQ to the right: its box counts up and FRQ itself does not move. Play soft and hard hits: harder ones open the filter.
Press AMP, hold SAMPLER and turn DEC: pad pressure now lengthens the decay.
Hold FIX and press FRQ's knob: the link goes back to 0, and its slot is free for another parameter.

access.location: The FIX and SAMPLER keys, on a sound track's pages and in PERF, SCNE, MUTE and CHRO.
steps: Select a sound track and open its SYNTH, SAMPLE, FILTER, AMP or LFO page.
Hold FIX: linked knobs show their velocity amounts. Turn a knob to link it or change its amount.
Hold SAMPLER for aftertouch: the aftertouch amounts.
Turn back to 0 to free the slot. Tap FIX alone to toggle fixed velocity, tap SAMPLER alone to open the recorder, as before.

limitations: Each sound has four velocity and four aftertouch mods; with all four in use a popup says VELOCITY MODS FULL or AFTERTOUCH MODS FULL.
A FIX tap toggles fixed velocity on the release instead of the press.
While FIX or SAMPLER is held, the TRIG page's knobs, knobs turned with a trig held and FUNC + a knob do nothing.
FUNC + FIX, the FX track and a performance, scene or trig lock edit keep stock's behaviour.

claims: ui:FIX + knob on the sound pages
ui:SAMPLER + knob on the sound pages
ui:FIX tap toggles fixed velocity on the release

load.conditions: UI only: runs on key events and knob turns, never in the audio path.

tests.summary: rytm-emu on QM11, QM12 and QM13 (-O2): links, lock-style display, MODS FULL popups, SAMPLER recorder, FIX toggle, PERF, SCNE and the FX track. Author's unit reports: RC18 (QM10: links, display, kit save, reload, power cycle), RC19 (QM11) and QM12 alone (FX track, links, FIX key, save, power cycle) pass.

media.alt: FIX plus a knob turn fills the first of four velocity mod slots with +20; SAMPLER plus a knob turn fills the first of four aftertouch slots with +10. A knob press sets a link to 0, and the links save with the kit.
